newsitem.title: USA: Beneficial Corp to buy back 1.2 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Beneficial Corp to buy back 1.2 mln shrs.

text.p: Beneficial Corp said on Thursday that its board of directors has authorized the repurchase of up to 1.2 million shares of the company's common stock, or about 2.2 percent of its outstanding stock.
The shares would be repurchased from time-to-time on the open market or in privately negotiated transactions, Beneficial said.
Beneficial has approximately 53.7 million shares currently outstanding, it said. Repurchased shares will be placed in the treasury and used for general corporate purposes.
Beneficial said it expects to receive dividends from its insurance, commercial banking, and Canadian subsidiaries totaling more than $160 million before year-end.
